fields.name: metaTitle
fields.label: Meta Title
fields.description: The title that appears in the browser tab and search engine results. Keep it under 60 characters.

fields.name: metaDescription
fields.label: Meta Description
fields.description: The short description that appears in search engine results. Keep it between 50-160 characters.

fields.name: ogImage
fields.label: Social Media Image (Open Graph)
fields.description: The image displayed when the page is shared on social media. Recommended size: 1200x630 pixels.

fields.name: siteName
fields.label: Site Name
fields.description: The official name of the brand (e.g., Siliwacore).

fields.name: siteTagline
fields.label: Site Tagline
fields.description: A short, catchy phrase for SEO and branding.

fields.name: description
fields.label: Description
fields.description: The helpful text explaining what happened.

fields.name: buttonText
fields.label: Button Text
fields.description: The text for the button that links back to the homepage (e.g., 'Return Home').

fields.name: image
fields.label: Optional Image
fields.description: An optional image to display on the page.

description.value: References another document, used as a foreign key
